svg.title: Figure 03 · Running estimates and pointwise confidence intervals
svg.desc: Exact terminal sampling; seed 1001. The shaded intervals are normal approximations at each displayed fixed sample size. They are not a simultaneous confidence band, and the nested estimates are strongly dependent.
